chapter_outcomes: CORE PRACTICAL 15: Investigate the absorption of gamma radiation by lead
understand the relationships between the nature, penetration, ionising ability and range in different materials of nuclear radiations (alpha, beta and gamma)
understand the spontaneous and random nature of nuclear decay

be able to determine the half-lives of radioactive isotopes graphically and be able to use the equations for radioactive decay: activity A = λN, dN/dt = −λN, t½ = ln2/λ, N = N₀e⁻λt and A = A₀e⁻λt and derive and use the corresponding log equations
